items.source_en:
Radim,

My role as a Herald compels me to remind you of the crucial role the Great Serpent plays in the healing process of those who enter here.

The spiritual guidance from our shrines and ceremonies are as essential as the medical treatments at the Halls of Healing. It is imperative to our citizens' wellbeing, and I urge you to reconsider the currently planned budget with a substantial increase for these matters.

I have observed a noticeable increase in recent budgets allocated to ever more expensive and specialized machines in the hospital. While these are undoubtedly important for our medical staff, it is vital to demonstrate an unwavering commitment to the ideals and teachings of Jinan.

Surely, the Head of Medicine would not wish to be seen as unsupportive of the Great Serpent's role in the full and complete healing of our citizens. 

Blessings,
Lamir

items.source_en:
I was at Herald's Rest today, having a drink. 

Stranger comes up to me, starts talking shop. They go on and on about an agent who died out in the Settled Systems, with the same disease that I don't got. 

I'm about to tell them to sloff off, but then they start spinning this yarn about employment in Dreshdae. They say I could've been sent home the day of the accident to work any number of jobs, but the request was denied by one Mujeen Ka'dic.

I hear this, and I'm furious. I can hear about twenty veins pop one after the other like a goddamn firecracker. Hell, I'm about to reach for my gun, walk up to my "father," and pop one in his skull. But the stranger tells me they have a better idea. 

So I listened.
items.legacy_ko:
오늘 전령의 안식처에서 술을 마시고 있었다.

낯선 녀석이 내게 다가와, 일 얘기를 주절주절 떠들기 시작했다. 개척 성계에서 죽은 어느 요원 이야기를 계속 해댔는데, 나는 걸려 본 적 없던 그 병에 걸려 죽었다고 했다.

녀석에게 꺼지라고 말할려고 했는데, 그자는 장황하게 드레스데의 일자리 얘기를 하기 시작했다. 그 인간 말로는 드레스데에 사태가 터진 직후, 어떤 일이든 맡을 일손이 필요하다는 요청이 있었고, 때문에 나도 언제든 귀환 가능했다고 했다. 근데 바로 무진 카딕이 귀환을 막았다는 것이다.

그 말을 듣자마자 화가 치밀어 올랐다. 내 혈관 수십 가닥 정도가 망할 폭죽처럼 터지는 소리가 들릴 정도로. 당장 나의 '양부' 그 작자에게 가서 면상에 총을 갈기고 싶은 심정이었다. 하지만 그 낯선 녀석은 더 좋은 생각이 있다고 했고...

그래서 계속 잠자코 들었다.
